svg.title: The seven predictions as experiments/question.py holds them, written before any run, each with the rule that will decide it
svg.text: PREDICTIONS, committed before the pilot ran
SMALLEST = 0.02: the smallest gap worth finding
one_block
Positions are worth the most to a GPT of one block, which cannot see order
at all without them.
held if the mean gap at 1 block is the largest
shrinks
The gap shrinks as blocks are added: the mask gives a deeper model more of
the order.
held if the mean gap falls at every step of depth
size_one
At one block the gap is more than 0.1 bits per character.
held if the gap's interval at 1 block is all above 0.1
again
At four blocks, each arm with its own searched rate, the gap is about
held if the mean gap at 4 blocks is within 0.0325 to 0.13
not_closed
No depth tried closes the gap: at the deepest, positions still help beyond
the noise.
held if the gap's interval at the deepest is all above 0
depth_no_substitute
Twice the blocks do not buy what positions buy: no positions at 8 blocks is
worse than learned positions at 4.
held if Welch's interval (none at the deepest, learned at 4 blocks) is above 0
not_weights
The positions' weights are not why they help: the same number of weights
given to the MLPs of a GPT without positions closes under a quarter of the
gap.
held if it closes under 25% of the gap at 4 blocks
The gap: no positions minus learned, test bits per character, one seed's pair; positive when positions help.
